title: [GMCP 203.002.02] Production path: JSON-RPC, protocol metadata, errors, cancellation, and negotiation
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-002-02. Implement the canonical state, types, and primary production path. Replace stubs, demo-only paths, duplicated semantics, and implicit ambient state; preserve compatible behavior through explicit adapters; and make the new path reachable from the shipped GMCP runtime. Vector outcome: GMCP implements the complete JSON-RPC substrate for every supported revision: identifiers and batches where applicable, notifications, cancellation, progress tokens, typed standard and MCP errors, required resultType, per-request protocol/capability metadata, trace context, and deterministic unsupported-version behavior. Malformed, duplicated, reordered, oversized, and adversarial messages fail predictably without corrupting another request. Done means production-path tests and retained evidence prove this work package; task closure or roadmap wording alone is not evidence.
